title: Integrated machine learning and single-cell analysis identify chromatin-remodeling gene signature for diagnosis and prognosis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
authors: Chang, Yuanyuan; Qin, Wanting; Chen, Weiling; Yan, Zhiyu; Xu, Yang; Ma, Shuhan; Zhu, Xiaodong
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习与单细胞分析构建鼻咽癌染色质重塑基因诊断/预后模型，虽涉及基因表达与免疫浸润，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟的结构建模，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: This study examines the function of chromatin-remodeling genes (CRGs) in nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), with an emphasis on their potential as prognostic and diagnostic biomarkers. We examined gene expression information collected from multiple datasets (GSE12452, GSE53819, GSE61218, and GSE102349) using a multi-stage methodology; we also performed differential expression, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and functional enrichment analyses to identify pathogenic CRGs. A prognostic signature of six key genes-CDC6, EZH2, PHF14, PRC1, RAD54B, and UHRF1-was developed through machine learning methods and further validated in independent datasets. The identified genes were used to build a diagnostic model, which performed well (AUC > 0.8) in both training and validation cohorts. This model was further refined using a nomogram and demonstrated high clinical utility, as confirmed by decision curve analysis and calibration curves. Furthermore, the study of immune infiltration showed a strong correlation between immune cell types and diagnostic genes, while single-cell RNA sequencing highlighted functional differences across epithelial subpopulations in NPC. Notably, experimental validation of PHF14 indicated its involvement in NPC malignancy, with downregulation of PHF14-suppressing cell migration, invasion, and proliferation. These discoveries give fresh perspectives on the molecular processes of NPC and offer potential biomarkers for clinical diagnosis and prognosis.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了染色质重塑基因（CRGs）在鼻咽癌（NPC）中的功能，重点强调其作为预后和诊断生物标志物的潜力。我们采用多阶段方法，检查了从多个数据集（GSE12452、GSE53819、GSE61218和GSE102349）收集的基因表达信息；同时进行了差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析和功能富集分析，以识别致病的CRGs。通过机器学习方法，我们开发了一个由六个关键基因——CDC6、EZH2、PHF14、PRC1、RAD54B和UHRF1——组成的预后特征，并在独立数据集中进行了进一步验证。利用所识别的基因构建了一个诊断模型，该模型在训练队列和验证队列中均表现良好（AUC > 0.8）。该模型进一步通过列线图进行优化，并通过决策曲线分析和校准曲线证实了其高度的临床实用性。此外，免疫浸润研究显示免疫细胞类型与诊断基因之间存在强相关性，而单细胞RNA测序则突显了NPC中上皮亚群之间的功能差异。值得注意的是，对PHF14的实验验证表明其参与NPC的恶性进程，下调PHF14可抑制细胞迁移、侵袭和增殖。这些发现为NPC的分子机制提供了新的视角，并为临床诊断和预后提供了潜在的生物标志物。
